mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% in the prior month signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise > 0.5% in 1 month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle slowdown regime (defined by prior economic indicators), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% in the prior month signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO declines > 0.5% in a late-cycle slowdown regime, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp acceleration in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 2.5% in the prior month signals heightened inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises > 2.5% in 1 month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When total employment (PAYEMS) exceeds its 12-month moving average, it signals a robust labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS > 12-month MA, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 thousand units in the prior month signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 1000 in 1 month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (relative to 2017=100) signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
